title: Whale in Cathedral Arcade
description: A luminous, translucent blue whale floats through the center of a grand, arched cathedral corridor at night. Small human figures and dogs walk along the stone floor beneath it, casting long shadows, while colorful balloons and glowing orbs drift nearby.
prompt: A massive translucent blue whale with swirling patterns floating inside a vast cathedral hallway with tall gothic arches and pillars, small human figures and dogs walking on the stone floor below, colorful balloons drifting, glowing orbs and stars in the twilight sky visible through the arches, mystical atmosphere, intricate architectural details, soft glowing light
